bundle.shortDescription: A local multi-bot AI workspace with a desktop robot.
bundle.longDescription: DeepSeek Bot Group Pet is a local macOS AI workspace. Multiple DeepSeek bots discuss in a group with role-based collaboration, a Muse-style text memory system, and a click-through desktop robot companion. Chat data and memories live in a local SQLite database.
